raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 delivered customer_id values without zero-padding (e.g. 'C8', 'C110' instead of 'C00008', 'C00110'), so the inner join to silver_customers drops those rows. About 334 rows are missing, which matches the POSTED rows in batch 13. Normalizing the ID to 'C' plus 5 digits in silver_transactions fixes the join and also keeps gold_customer_spend keyed consistently.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(customer_id), '^C[0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(trim(customer_id), 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
